label: CONTAINMENT_SCOPE_2, whole-effect: a total cause of a thing's being has every perfection of it
definition: `WholeEffectContainmentInTotalCause F Total`: whatever is the efficient and total cause of x's being (TotalCauseIn at esse) is in act in every perfection r in which x is in act. The cause of the whole effect is constrained for every perfection of the effect. Act is read uniformly as IN_ACT_4 on both sides.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, the stone example: a stone that did not exist cannot begin to exist unless produced by something containing, formally or eminently, everything in the stone). It is the total-cause restriction of q.4 a.2 preexistence (STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE), which entails it.
